mcq.question: Why does the server need a `LineFramer` at all?

options.A: TCP sends one line per packet
options.C: TCP delivers bytes in arbitrary pieces, so lines must be reassembled

mcq.explanation: One `recv` may contain half a line or three lines. The framer turns bytes back into messages.

mcq.question: What is the benefit of the core writing to an `Outbox` instead of sockets?

options.B: It avoids the need for sessions
options.D: The same code works behind TCP, WebSockets or a test, and tests need no network

mcq.explanation: Transport independence keeps protocol logic testable and portable.

bonus.question: How would you add rate limiting so one client cannot flood a room?
Add a `TOPIC <#room> <text>` command that sets a room topic, announces it, and is sent to people when they join.
